reviewer_id.description: Stable identifier of the reviewer, normally a model id. Must differ from the first-pass reviewer_id.

evidence_fragment.description: Must appear literally in the evidence source_text.

strongest_counter_reading.description: The strongest alternative reading of this evidence, stated even when the reviewer agrees with the first pass.

what_would_falsify.description: A concrete observation that would overturn this reading. Written for a human to check without trusting either model.
